title: The transported control-arm check as a classifier
question: Does agreement between a MAIC-transported control arm and the target's observed control arm tell an analyst whether the anchored relative effect is biased?
design: Anchored binary-outcome MAIC with an unmeasured prognostic covariate and an unmeasured effect modifier shifted independently between populations, 18 cells; the check's alarm rate and the contrast's bias per cell. 1000 replicates per cell.
